name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based input buffer with optional Android touch controls for stage cycling and the status panel.

custom-ticks.name: Custom stage: max delay (ticks)
custom-ticks.description: Max delay for the CUSTOM stage, all modes except wave. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60fps.

custom-wave-ticks.name: Custom stage: max wave delay (ticks)
custom-wave-ticks.description: Max delay for the CUSTOM stage while in wave.

sim-budget-ms.name: Prediction time budget (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: Max time spent predicting per click. Higher values may find longer saves but can hitch on dense levels.

smart-prediction.name: Orb / pad / portal prediction
smart-prediction.description: Let the ghost use orbs, pads, gravity portals and speed portals. Turn off if you see object glitches.

debug-console.name: Debug console window (Windows only)
debug-console.description: Opens a separate Windows console. On Android, use the in-game LOG panel instead.

mobile-controls.name: Mobile touch controls
mobile-controls.description: Shows BUF (cycle stage) and LOG (toggle status panel) buttons during gameplay.
